description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting, including warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms. It includes class and method declarations for handling warning events, categorization, and configuration within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, managing warning events and category configurations.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects used to exclude or configure warning categories, and clone warning events.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Method to report a warning event with an identifier and event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Method to retrieve information about a specific warning category, including its default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Method to add a warning category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Method to remove a warning category control from the category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Method to exclude a specific warning category.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Method to configure settings for a warning category.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Method to clone a warning event object.
